title: PIL Consideration and Buyback-Cost Schedule - EDNA
content:
PULSE INTELLIGENCE LABS, INC.
CONSIDERATION AND BUYBACK-COST SCHEDULE
Schedule B record under Sections 2.3 and 3.5 of the Strategic Vesting Share Agreement with EDNA, Inc.

For signature following required corporate and mutual approval.

Prepared September 23, 2026. Determination Date: the date of electronic approval by PIL's sole director. This schedule is submitted to the sole director of Pulse Intelligence Labs, Inc., a Delaware corporation (the "Company" or "PIL"), for approval of the following determinations for the Strategic Share Award and Strategic Partnership Warrant in favor of EDNA, Inc. ("EDNA"). Capitalized terms not defined here have the meanings given in the Strategic Vesting Share Agreement (the "Share Agreement").

1. FAIR MARKET VALUE OF COMMON STOCK
The fair market value submitted for determination by the Company's sole director is $0.01 per share of Common Stock as of the Determination Date. This is PIL's stated board determination for approval, not an independent valuation. The stated rationale is that the Company is at an early stage with limited revenue (a single $5,000 paid pilot); that founder shares were issued at par value in December 2025; that the Company has completed no priced equity financing; that its only outside investment is a $25,000 convertible note with a $1,000,000 Target Valuation and conversion rights governed by the note's conditional pricing provisions; and that Common Stock is illiquid and subject to transfer restrictions.

2. CONSIDERATION FOR THE SHARE AWARD
EDNA's strategic undertakings and contributions under the Partnership Agreement and Side Letter, including commercialization, integration, institutional development, pilots, and joint implementation, are the consideration for the 200,000-share Strategic Share Award. No cash is payable. The determination submitted for the board's approval is that this consideration is legally sufficient for issuance and has a value equal to the stated fair market value of the award shares.

Item | Value
Shares under the Share Award | 200,000
Stated value per share (Section 1) | $0.01
Aggregate noncash consideration value | $2,000

3. CONTRACTUAL REPURCHASE PRICE
Subject to the written adoption described below, the contractual repurchase price under Section 3.5 of the Share Agreement is $0.10 for each original award share actually repurchased, or $20,000 for all 200,000 original award shares. A partial repurchase is proportional: 50,000 shares cost $5,000; 100,000 shares cost $10,000. The price is fixed, does not increase with subsequent appreciation, and adjusts proportionately for stock splits and similar recapitalizations to preserve the $20,000 full-award amount.

This negotiated price is separate from the $0.01 stated fair market value and noncash-consideration allocation in Sections 1 and 2. It is not an original-acquisition-cost determination. The parties propose matching reciprocal pricing for EDNA's separate 200,000-share award to PIL, subject to EDNA's approval and written adoption; a different confirmed share count requires a corresponding written price adjustment preserving the agreed full-award amount.

The contractual price replaces original-acquisition-cost pricing only when both companies adopt it in writing, obtain required corporate approvals, and conform Section 3.5(c) of the Share Agreement, the Side Letter and the applicable reciprocal definitive agreement. Those definitive instruments govern effectiveness, eligible award shares, Repurchase Events, notice, cure, required determinations, exercise and closing procedures, disputes and legal limitations. This schedule expands no trigger and creates no repurchase right solely upon ordinary expiration, nonrenewal or termination. Warrant shares are excluded.

4. STRATEGIC PARTNERSHIP WARRANT
Item | Value
Maximum shares | 200,000
Exercise price per share (not less than stated fair market value in Section 1) | $0.01
Aggregate exercise price | $2,000

The Warrant's vesting, exercise, term and other purchase mechanics remain governed by the separate Warrant. Its exercise price is unchanged by the contractual repurchase price in Section 3.

5. SHARE AWARD VESTING SCHEDULE
Vesting commences September 11, 2026. 50,000 shares vest on September 11, 2027, and the remaining 150,000 shares vest in 36 monthly installments, with the final installment on September 11, 2030. Vesting remains subject to Sections 3 and 6 of the Share Agreement.
